notes.title: Spring Update released
notes.content:
Hello guys,

I have just published a spring update.

The changes are as follows:
[list]
[*] You will receive a health boost after each 20 coins
[*] Informational dialog/menu that guides you through the game and tells a bit of the story
[*] Achievement for each map that rewards if all coins are collected
[*] More waves in the levels and partially more enemies in each wave
[*] Boss is a bit stronger now
[*] Game starts in windowed mode by default
[/list]

Have fun with the updated game!
